body.en: Questions from Reading Comprehension come in all kinds of competitive examinations. Answering such questions requires Reading Skill. Reading is a skill that can be acquired by mastering a number of strategies. But before mastering these strategies, one must first gain an idea of what Reading means, the types of Reading, what the Reading process is like, for what reasons Reading can become difficult, and by mastering which strategies Reading can be done easily. All these matters are discussed in this chapter.

body.mix: Reading শব্দের আভিধানিক অর্থ পাঠ করা। তবে সকল পাঠই Reading হিসেবে গণ্য হয় না। বর্ণ, শব্দ কিংবা বাক্য উচ্চারণ করাকে Reading বলে না। যদি কোনো পাঠক বর্ণ, শব্দ ও বাক্য উচ্চারণের মধ্য দিয়ে অর্থ উদ্ধার করতে পারে, তবেই তার পাঠকে Reading বলা হয়। আবার শুধু অর্থ উদ্ধার করতে পারলেই তাকে দক্ষ পাঠক বলা যায় না। অর্থ উদ্ধারের পাশাপাশি বক্তব্যের অন্তর্নিহিত ভাব (implied meaning), লেখকের মনোভাব (writer's attitude), রচনার প্রকৃতি ও বৈশিষ্ট্য (nature & features) প্রভৃতি অনুধাবন করতে হয়। এছাড়া সফল পাঠককে পঠিত বিষয়বস্তুর মূল্যায়ন (evaluate) করতে হয়। পঠিত বিষয় মূল্যায়ন বলতে বিষয়বস্তুর ভালো-মন্দ, গ্রহণযোগ্যতা-অগ্রহণযোগ্যতা, যৌক্তিক-অযৌক্তিক, সঙ্গত-অসঙ্গত প্রভৃতি যাচাই করাকে বোঝায়। সফল Reading-এর জন্য পাঠককে পঠিত বিষয়ের তাৎপর্য (significance) এবং সমকালীন সমাজ ও সংস্কৃতির প্রেক্ষাপটে তার প্রাসঙ্গিকতা (relevance) বিচার করতে হয়।
body.en: The dictionary meaning of the word Reading is to read. But not all reading counts as Reading. Pronouncing letters, words or sentences is not called Reading. Only if a reader can recover the meaning through pronouncing letters, words and sentences is his reading called Reading. Again, a reader cannot be called skilled merely for recovering the meaning. Along with recovering the meaning, one must grasp the implied meaning of the statement, the writer's attitude, the nature and features of the writing, and so on. Besides, a successful reader must evaluate the material read. Evaluating the material read means examining its good and bad, acceptability and unacceptability, logical and illogical, consistent and inconsistent aspects. For successful Reading, the reader must judge the significance of the material read and its relevance in the context of contemporary society and culture.

body.en: In the Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary, Reading is defined as — 'the act of reading and understanding written or printed words'. On the other hand, the Longman Dictionary of Language Teaching & Applied Linguistics says — 'perceiving a written text in order to understand its contents'. That is, reading a text with understanding is Reading.

body.mix: পাঠের উদ্দেশ্য, গতি ও প্রকৃতি বিচারে Reading-কে চার ভাগে ভাগ করা যায় : 1. Extensive Reading 2. Intensive Reading 3. Skimming 4. Scanning। Extensive Reading বলতে বোঝায় — Reading for pleasure. এই প্রকার Reading-এ নির্দিষ্ট কোনো তথ্যের প্রয়োজন হয় না। কোনো কিছু জানার জন্য নয়, বরং নিছক আনন্দ লাভের জন্য কোনো কিছু পড়া হলে তা হবে Extensive Reading। এক্ষেত্রে লম্বা কোনো Text নির্বাচন করতে হয়, যা সহজ ভাষায় লিখিত। উপন্যাস, ছোটগল্প, নাটক, ভ্রমণ কাহিনী প্রভৃতি Extensive Reading-এর আওতায় পড়ে।
body.en: Considering the purpose, speed and nature of reading, Reading can be divided into four kinds: 1. Extensive Reading 2. Intensive Reading 3. Skimming 4. Scanning. Extensive Reading means — Reading for pleasure. In this kind of Reading no specific information is needed. Reading something not to know anything, but purely for pleasure, is Extensive Reading. In this case a long Text written in easy language has to be chosen. Novels, short stories, plays, travel accounts and so on fall under Extensive Reading.

body.mix: Intensive Reading বলতে কোনো বিষয় গভীর মনোযোগের সঙ্গে খুঁটিয়ে খুঁটিয়ে পড়াকে বোঝায়। এখানে Reading for specific information-এর ওপর জোর দেওয়া হয়। এই প্রকার Reading-এ ব্যবহৃত Text-টি তুলনামূলকভাবে ছোট এবং কঠিন হয়ে থাকে। Text-এর প্রতিটি খুঁটিনাটি বিষয়ের প্রতি নজর রাখা হয়।
body.en: Intensive Reading means reading a subject in detail with deep attention. Here emphasis is given to Reading for specific information. The Text used in this kind of Reading is comparatively short and difficult. Attention is paid to every detail of the Text.

body.mix: Skimming হচ্ছে দ্রুত কোনো Passage পড়ে তার মূল বক্তব্য অনুধাবন করা। এই প্রকার Reading-এ সম্পূর্ণ Passage-টি পড়ার দরকার হয় না। এক্ষেত্রে পাঠক বক্তব্যের মূল সুরটুকু ধরতে চেষ্টা করেন। এখানে প্রতিটি শব্দ বা বাক্যের অর্থ উদ্ধারের প্রয়োজন হয় না।
body.en: Skimming is reading a Passage quickly to grasp its main statement. In this kind of Reading the whole Passage need not be read. Here the reader tries to catch the main tone of the statement. Here the meaning of every word or sentence need not be recovered.

body.mix: নির্দিষ্ট তথ্য খোঁজার জন্য Scanning করা হয়। এই প্রকার Reading-এ সম্পূর্ণ Text পড়ার দরকার হয় না। শুধু প্রয়োজনীয় তথ্যটুকু জানার চেষ্টা করা হয়। যেমন — একটি অভিধানে কোনো নির্দিষ্ট শব্দের অর্থ অনুসন্ধান।
body.en: Scanning is done to search for specific information. In this kind of Reading the whole Text need not be read. Only the necessary information is sought. For example — searching for the meaning of a specific word in a dictionary.

Unfamiliar Vocabulary : কোনো Passage-এর অর্থ অনুধাবনের ক্ষেত্রে সবচেয়ে বড় অন্তরায় হচ্ছে অপরিচিত শব্দ। Passage-এর কোনো কোনো শব্দ অপরিচিত মনে হতে পারে। তাই বলে সবগুলো অপরিচিত শব্দের অর্থ জানা জরুরি নয়। প্রশ্নের ধরন অনুসারে দু'একটি শব্দের অর্থ জানার প্রয়োজন হতে পারে। এক্ষেত্রে পাঠককে সংশ্লিষ্ট শব্দের পারিপার্শ্বিক অর্থাৎ প্রসঙ্গ (context) লক্ষ্য করতে হবে। অপরিচিত শব্দটি যে বাক্যে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে ঐ বাক্যের অন্যান্য শব্দ, বাক্যটির আগের ও পরের বাক্য এবং সম্পূর্ণ Passage-এর মূলভাব বিবেচনা করে অপরিচিত শব্দটির অর্থ অনুমান করা যায়।
body.en: 2. Unfamiliar Vocabulary: the biggest obstacle to understanding the meaning of a Passage is unfamiliar words. Some words of a Passage may seem unfamiliar. But it is not necessary to know the meaning of all the unfamiliar words. According to the type of question, the meaning of one or two words may need to be known. In this case the reader must observe the surroundings of the word concerned, that is, the context. The meaning of an unfamiliar word can be guessed by considering the other words of the sentence in which it is used, the sentences before and after it, and the main idea of the whole Passage.

body.mix: ৩. Complex Sentence : অনেক লেখক কঠিন বাক্য (complex sentence) ব্যবহার করে থাকেন। সেক্ষেত্রে পাঠককে জটিল বাক্যের সরল অর্থ অনুধাবন করার কৌশল আয়ত্ত করতে হবে। বাক্যের Main Clause চিহ্নিত করে অন্যান্য clause-এর সঙ্গে এর সম্পর্ক নিরূপণ করতে পারলে জটিল বাক্যের অর্থ সহজেই অনুধাবন করা যায়। বাক্য দীর্ঘ হলেই তা complex হয় না। অনেক সময় সংক্ষিপ্ত বাক্যও complex রূপ ধারণ করে।
body.en: 3. Complex Sentence: many writers use difficult sentences (complex sentences). In that case the reader must master the strategy of grasping the simple meaning of a complex sentence. If the Main Clause of a sentence can be identified and its relation with the other clauses determined, the meaning of a complex sentence can be grasped easily. A sentence does not become complex merely by being long. Sometimes even a short sentence takes a complex form.

body.en: 4. Unfamiliar Cultural Background/Style: the cultural background or style of narration of some Texts being unfamiliar, Reading can become difficult. In this case one must read the Text patiently and try to grasp its main idea.
body.bn: ৪. Unfamiliar Cultural Background/Style : কোনো কোনো Text-এর সাংস্কৃতিক প্রেক্ষাপট বা বর্ণনাভঙ্গি অপরিচিত হওয়ায় Reading দুরূহ হয়ে উঠতে পারে। এক্ষেত্রে ধৈর্য ধরে Text-টি পড়ে তার মূলভাব অনুধাবনের চেষ্টা করতে হবে।

body.mix: পাঠকের পূর্বজ্ঞান বা Background Knowledge Reading-এর ক্ষেত্রে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ভূমিকা পালন করে। কোনো বিষয়ে পূর্বজ্ঞান থাকলে সেই বিষয়ের Text সহজে অনুধাবন করা যায়। পূর্বজ্ঞান না থাকলে Text-এর তথ্যগুলোকে সুশৃঙ্খলভাবে কাজে লাগিয়ে উত্তর খুঁজতে হয়।
body.en: The reader's prior knowledge or Background Knowledge plays an important role in Reading. If one has prior knowledge of a subject, the Text on that subject can be grasped easily. If there is no prior knowledge, the information of the Text must be used in an orderly way to find the answers.
body.bn: পাঠকের পূর্বজ্ঞান বা Background Knowledge Reading-এর ক্ষেত্রে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ভূমিকা পালন করে। কোনো বিষয়ে পূর্বজ্ঞান থাকলে সেই বিষয়ের Text সহজে অনুধাবন করা যায়। পূর্বজ্ঞান না থাকলে Text-এর তথ্যগুলোকে সুশৃঙ্খলভাবে কাজে লাগিয়ে উত্তর খুঁজতে হয়।

body.mix: Reading প্রক্রিয়া দুই ধরনের : Top-down Process এবং Bottom-up Process। Top-down Process-এ পাঠক তার পূর্বজ্ঞান ও অভিজ্ঞতা কাজে লাগিয়ে Text-এর অর্থ অনুমান করেন এবং পড়তে পড়তে সেই অনুমান যাচাই করেন।
body.en: The Reading process is of two kinds: Top-down Process and Bottom-up Process. In the Top-down Process the reader uses his prior knowledge and experience to guess the meaning of the Text and verifies that guess as he reads on.
body.bn: Reading প্রক্রিয়া দুই ধরনের : Top-down Process এবং Bottom-up Process। Top-down Process-এ পাঠক তার পূর্বজ্ঞান ও অভিজ্ঞতা কাজে লাগিয়ে Text-এর অর্থ অনুমান করেন এবং পড়তে পড়তে সেই অনুমান যাচাই করেন।

body.mix: Bottom-up Process-এ পাঠক শব্দের অর্থ, বাক্যের গঠন প্রভৃতি ক্ষুদ্র ক্ষুদ্র উপাদান থেকে শুরু করে ধাপে ধাপে সম্পূর্ণ Text-এর অর্থ অনুধাবন করেন।
body.en: In the Bottom-up Process the reader starts from small elements such as the meanings of words and the structure of sentences and gradually grasps the meaning of the whole Text step by step.
body.bn: Bottom-up Process-এ পাঠক শব্দের অর্থ, বাক্যের গঠন প্রভৃতি ক্ষুদ্র ক্ষুদ্র উপাদান থেকে শুরু করে ধাপে ধাপে সম্পূর্ণ Text-এর অর্থ অনুধাবন করেন।

body.mix: বাস্তবে সফল Reading-এর ক্ষেত্রে Top-down ও Bottom-up — উভয় প্রক্রিয়াই একসঙ্গে কাজ করে। একেই Interactive Process বলা হয়। দক্ষ পাঠক প্রয়োজন অনুসারে উভয় প্রক্রিয়ার সমন্বয় ঘটান।
body.en: In reality, in successful Reading both processes — Top-down and Bottom-up — work together. This is called the Interactive Process. A skilled reader combines both processes as needed.
body.bn: বাস্তবে সফল Reading-এর ক্ষেত্রে Top-down ও Bottom-up — উভয় প্রক্রিয়াই একসঙ্গে কাজ করে। একেই Interactive Process বলা হয়। দক্ষ পাঠক প্রয়োজন অনুসারে উভয় প্রক্রিয়ার সমন্বয় ঘটান।

body.mix: Reading-এর কৌশল বলতে সেই সব পদ্ধতিকে বোঝায় যেগুলো আয়ত্ত করলে একজন পাঠক সহজে ও দ্রুত কোনো Text পড়ে তার অর্থ অনুধাবন করতে পারেন এবং প্রশ্নের উত্তর দিতে পারেন। নিচে প্রধান কৌশলগুলো আলোচনা করা হলো।
body.en: Strategies of Reading mean those methods by mastering which a reader can read a Text easily and quickly, grasp its meaning and answer the questions. The main strategies are discussed below.
body.bn: Reading-এর কৌশল বলতে সেই সব পদ্ধতিকে বোঝায় যেগুলো আয়ত্ত করলে একজন পাঠক সহজে ও দ্রুত কোনো Text পড়ে তার অর্থ অনুধাবন করতে পারেন এবং প্রশ্নের উত্তর দিতে পারেন। নিচে প্রধান কৌশলগুলো আলোচনা করা হলো।

body.mix: প্রথমে প্রশ্নগুলো পড়ে নিলে Passage-এ কোন কোন তথ্য খুঁজতে হবে তা আগে থেকেই জানা যায়, ফলে Passage পড়ার সময় সংশ্লিষ্ট তথ্যের প্রতি মনোযোগ দেওয়া সহজ হয়।
body.en: If the questions are read first, one knows in advance which information to look for in the Passage, so it becomes easy to pay attention to the relevant information while reading the Passage.

body.mix: Passage-এ ব্যবহৃত Pronoun ও অন্যান্য Reference Word কোন Noun বা বিষয়কে নির্দেশ করছে তা শনাক্ত করতে পারলে অনেক প্রশ্নের উত্তর সহজে দেওয়া যায়।
body.en: If one can identify which Noun or subject the Pronouns and other Reference Words used in the Passage refer to, many questions can be answered easily.

body.mix: অপরিচিত শব্দের অর্থ অভিধান না দেখে প্রসঙ্গ (context) থেকে অনুমান করার কৌশল আয়ত্ত করতে হবে। শব্দটির আগে-পরের বাক্য ও মূলভাব বিবেচনা করে অর্থ অনুমান করা যায়।
body.en: The strategy of guessing the meaning of an unfamiliar word from the context, without looking at a dictionary, must be mastered. The meaning can be guessed by considering the sentences before and after the word and the main idea.

body.mix: (Italic)-এর ব্যবহার বিভিন্ন কারণে বা উদ্দেশ্যে passage-এ দেয়া থাকতে পারে। যেমন — কঠিন শব্দ, যা সম্বন্ধে পরে প্রশ্ন করা হবে তা Bold করে দেয়া থাকতে পারে — The total annual precipitation of an area with fourty inches of rain ....; বাক্যের মধ্যে কোনো শব্দ Capital letter দিয়ে শুরু হলে বুঝতে হবে এটি Proper noun; কোনো বই বা ফিল্মের নাম Italic করে দেয়া থাকতে পারে — The jewish character is successfully depicted in The Merchannt of Venice.; বিদেশী শব্দ বা শব্দগুচ্ছ Italic করা থাকে — A species of viola is viola calaminaria.; কোনো বিশেষ Word বা Phrase বিশেষভাবে উল্লেখ করতে — We can't understand what they called total satisfaction.
body.en: (Italics) may be used in a passage for various reasons or purposes. For example — a difficult word, about which a question will be asked later, may be given in Bold — The total annual precipitation of an area with fourty inches of rain ....; if a word in the middle of a sentence starts with a Capital letter, it must be understood to be a Proper noun; the name of a book or film may be given in Italic — The jewish character is successfully depicted in The Merchannt of Venice.; a foreign word or phrase is Italicised — A species of viola is viola calaminaria.; to mention a special Word or Phrase specially — We can't understand what they called total satisfaction.

body.mix: Pre-reading Activities : মূল Reading শুরু করার আগে এমন কিছু কাজ আছে যা করলে comprehension-এর কাজ অনেক দূর এগিয়ে যেতে পারে। Pre-reading-এর মধ্যে থাকতে পারে — Title বা শিরোনাম পাঠ; প্রথম প্যারাগ্রাফের প্রথম দুটি বাক্য পাঠ; প্রতিটি প্যারাগ্রাফের ১ম ও শেষ বাক্য পাঠ; Topic sentence বা মূল বাক্যটি সনাক্তকরণ। সাধারণত Passage-এর শিরোনাম (যদি থাকে) দেখেই এর বিষয়বস্তু অনুমান করা যায়। শিরোনাম না থাকলে অনেক সময় প্যারাগ্রাফের ১ম বা শেষ বাক্যে আসল কথাটি বলা থাকে। আর যদি Topic sentence-টি কোনো রকমে সনাক্ত করা যায় তাহলে তো কথাই নেই — পড়ার আগেই Reading শেষ!
body.en: Pre-reading Activities: before starting the main Reading there are some tasks which, if done, can advance the work of comprehension a long way. Pre-reading may include — reading the Title; reading the first two sentences of the first paragraph; reading the 1st and last sentence of every paragraph; identifying the Topic sentence or main sentence. Generally the subject matter of a Passage can be guessed just by seeing its title (if any). If there is no title, the main point is often stated in the 1st or last sentence of a paragraph. And if the Topic sentence can somehow be identified, then that is it — the Reading is finished before reading!

body.mix: Skimming : Reading-এর প্রধান কৌশল হচ্ছে Skimming। Skimming অর্থ — Glancing rapidly through a text to determine its gist. অর্থাৎ মূল বিষয়বস্তু জানার জন্য কোনো Passage-এর ওপর দ্রুতবেগে চোখ বুলানোকে Skimming বলা হয়। এ ক্ষেত্রে Top-down process of reading প্রয়োগ করা হয়। কোনো Passage-এর Title বা শিরোনাম নির্ধারণ অথবা লেখকের ব্যঞ্জনার্থ (implication) নির্বাচন সংক্রান্ত প্রশ্নের উত্তর দিতে skimming অত্যাবশ্যক কৌশল। যেমন — Q. Which title fits the passage best? Q. Which topics are deals with in this passage? Q. Which of these statements deals with the topic described in the passage?
body.en: Skimming: the main strategy of Reading is Skimming. Skimming means — Glancing rapidly through a text to determine its gist. That is, running one's eyes rapidly over a Passage to know its main subject matter is called Skimming. In this case the Top-down process of reading is applied. Skimming is an essential strategy for answering questions about determining the Title of a Passage or selecting the writer's implication. For example — Q. Which title fits the passage best? Q. Which topics are deals with in this passage? Q. Which of these statements deals with the topic described in the passage?

body.mix: Scanning : Comprehension-এর অধিকাংশ প্রশ্নোত্তর এই কৌশল ছাড়া অসম্ভব। scanning অর্থ — Glancing rapidly through a text either to search for a specific piece of information (eg. name, date etc) or to get an initial impression of difficulty level. অর্থাৎ Passage-এ বর্ণিত কোনো সুনির্দিষ্ট তথ্য (যেমন — নাম, সন বা তারিখ) বের করার জন্য অথবা Passage-টি কতটা কঠিন তা নির্ণয়ের জন্য Passage-এর ওপর দিয়ে দ্রুত চোখ বুলানোকে Scanning বলে। যেসব বিষয় খুঁজতে Scanning ব্যবহৃত হয় তা হচ্ছে — ব্যক্তি, বস্তু, স্থানের নাম বের করতে; কোনো সন বা তারিখ খুঁজতে; কতটি বিষয় বা কতজন ব্যক্তি সম্বন্ধে আলোচনা করা হয়েছে; ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুর মধ্যে সম্পর্ক বের করতে; Pronoun-এর Reference বের করতে।
body.en: Scanning: answering most questions of Comprehension is impossible without this strategy. Scanning means — Glancing rapidly through a text either to search for a specific piece of information (eg. name, date etc) or to get an initial impression of difficulty level. That is, running one's eyes rapidly over a Passage to find a specific piece of information stated in it (for example — a name, year or date), or to determine how difficult the Passage is, is called Scanning. The things for which Scanning is used are — to find the name of a person, thing or place; to search for a year or date; how many subjects or how many persons have been discussed; to find the relation between a person or thing; to find the Reference of a Pronoun.

body.mix: প্রতিটি Passage-এর একটি Main Idea থাকে এবং Supporting Details সেই মূল ভাবকেই সমর্থন করে। Main Idea সংক্রান্ত প্রশ্নের উত্তরে Supporting Detail নির্বাচন করলে ভুল হবে; আবার Detail সংক্রান্ত প্রশ্নে নির্দিষ্ট তথ্যটিই বেছে নিতে হবে।
body.en: Every Passage has a Main Idea and the Supporting Details support that main idea. Choosing a Supporting Detail in answer to a Main Idea question will be wrong; again, in a Detail question the specific information itself must be chosen.
body.bn: প্রতিটি Passage-এর একটি Main Idea থাকে এবং Supporting Details সেই মূল ভাবকেই সমর্থন করে। Main Idea সংক্রান্ত প্রশ্নের উত্তরে Supporting Detail নির্বাচন করলে ভুল হবে; আবার Detail সংক্রান্ত প্রশ্নে নির্দিষ্ট তথ্যটিই বেছে নিতে হবে।

body.mix: কোনো কোনো প্রশ্নের উত্তর Passage-এ সরাসরি বলা থাকে না; Passage-এর তথ্য থেকে যুক্তিসঙ্গত সিদ্ধান্ত (inference) টেনে উত্তর দিতে হয়। এক্ষেত্রে Passage-এর বাইরের কোনো ধারণা প্রয়োগ করা যাবে না।
body.en: The answers to some questions are not stated directly in the Passage; the answer must be given by drawing a reasonable conclusion (inference) from the information of the Passage. In this case no idea from outside the Passage can be applied.
body.bn: কোনো কোনো প্রশ্নের উত্তর Passage-এ সরাসরি বলা থাকে না; Passage-এর তথ্য থেকে যুক্তিসঙ্গত সিদ্ধান্ত (inference) টেনে উত্তর দিতে হয়। এক্ষেত্রে Passage-এর বাইরের কোনো ধারণা প্রয়োগ করা যাবে না।

body.mix: লেখকের Tone বা Attitude বুঝতে হলে তার ব্যবহৃত শব্দচয়ন, বিশেষ করে Adjective ও Adverb-এর প্রতি লক্ষ্য রাখতে হবে। প্রশংসাসূচক, সমালোচনামূলক, নিরপেক্ষ প্রভৃতি মনোভাব শব্দচয়ন থেকেই ধরা যায়।
body.en: To understand the writer's Tone or Attitude, one must observe his choice of words, especially the Adjectives and Adverbs. Attitudes such as appreciative, critical, neutral and so on can be caught from the choice of words.
body.bn: লেখকের Tone বা Attitude বুঝতে হলে তার ব্যবহৃত শব্দচয়ন, বিশেষ করে Adjective ও Adverb-এর প্রতি লক্ষ্য রাখতে হবে। প্রশংসাসূচক, সমালোচনামূলক, নিরপেক্ষ প্রভৃতি মনোভাব শব্দচয়ন থেকেই ধরা যায়।

body.mix: Vocabulary সংক্রান্ত প্রশ্নে শব্দটির আভিধানিক অর্থের বদলে Passage-এ ব্যবহৃত প্রাসঙ্গিক অর্থটিই উত্তর হবে। একই শব্দের একাধিক অর্থ থাকতে পারে; প্রসঙ্গ অনুযায়ী সঠিক অর্থ বেছে নিতে হবে।
body.en: In a Vocabulary question, the answer will be the contextual meaning used in the Passage, not the dictionary meaning of the word. The same word can have several meanings; the correct meaning must be chosen according to the context.
body.bn: Vocabulary সংক্রান্ত প্রশ্নে শব্দটির আভিধানিক অর্থের বদলে Passage-এ ব্যবহৃত প্রাসঙ্গিক অর্থটিই উত্তর হবে। একই শব্দের একাধিক অর্থ থাকতে পারে; প্রসঙ্গ অনুযায়ী সঠিক অর্থ বেছে নিতে হবে।

body.mix: যেসব প্রশ্নে NOT, EXCEPT, False প্রভৃতি শব্দ থাকে, সেগুলোতে সতর্ক থাকতে হবে — এক্ষেত্রে যেটি সত্য নয় বা Passage অনুযায়ী নয়, সেটিই উত্তর। বাকি তিনটি Option Passage অনুযায়ী সত্য হবে।
body.en: In questions containing words like NOT, EXCEPT, False, one must be careful — here the answer is the one that is not true or not according to the Passage. The other three Options will be true according to the Passage.
body.bn: যেসব প্রশ্নে NOT, EXCEPT, False প্রভৃতি শব্দ থাকে, সেগুলোতে সতর্ক থাকতে হবে — এক্ষেত্রে যেটি সত্য নয় বা Passage অনুযায়ী নয়, সেটিই উত্তর। বাকি তিনটি Option Passage অনুযায়ী সত্য হবে।

body.mix: Passage-এর জন্য উপযুক্ত Title নির্বাচনের প্রশ্নে এমন Option বেছে নিতে হবে যা সম্পূর্ণ Passage-এর মূলভাবকে ধারণ করে — খুব সংকীর্ণ (শুধু একটি অংশের) বা খুব ব্যাপক Option উত্তর হবে না।
body.en: In a question asking for a suitable Title for a Passage, one must choose the Option that holds the main idea of the whole Passage — an Option that is too narrow (of only one part) or too broad will not be the answer.
body.bn: Passage-এর জন্য উপযুক্ত Title নির্বাচনের প্রশ্নে এমন Option বেছে নিতে হবে যা সম্পূর্ণ Passage-এর মূলভাবকে ধারণ করে — খুব সংকীর্ণ (শুধু একটি অংশের) বা খুব ব্যাপক Option উত্তর হবে না।

body.mix: পরীক্ষায় নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের মধ্যে সব প্রশ্নের উত্তর দিতে হয়। তাই কোনো একটি প্রশ্নে অতিরিক্ত সময় নষ্ট না করে এগিয়ে যেতে হবে এবং সহজ প্রশ্নগুলো আগে উত্তর করে কঠিনগুলো পরে চেষ্টা করতে হবে।
body.en: In the examination all questions must be answered within a fixed time. So one must move on without wasting extra time on any one question, answer the easy questions first and try the difficult ones later.
body.bn: পরীক্ষায় নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের মধ্যে সব প্রশ্নের উত্তর দিতে হয়। তাই কোনো একটি প্রশ্নে অতিরিক্ত সময় নষ্ট না করে এগিয়ে যেতে হবে এবং সহজ প্রশ্নগুলো আগে উত্তর করে কঠিনগুলো পরে চেষ্টা করতে হবে।

body.en: There is a difference between general Reading and the Reading of Comprehension. In general reading the reader reads at his own speed and according to his interest; but in Comprehension the Passage must be read and specific questions answered within a fixed time. In Comprehension the reader's aim is to find the answers to the questions, so the Skimming and Scanning strategies are used more here.

body.mix: 'Bacteria' is the common name of a very large group of one-celled microscopic organism that, we believe, may be the smallest, simplest, and perhaps even the very first form of cellular life that evolved on earth. That is why they are observable only under a microscope. There are three main types of bacteria, which are classified according to their shape. The bacilli are a group of bacteria that occur in the soil and air. They are shaped like rods. If we look at them under a microscope, we find them in motion, they always seem to be rolling or tumbling under the microscope. These bacilli are largely responsible for food spoilage. There is another type of bacteria who tend to grow in chains. They are referred to as the cocci group. A common example of this type is streptococci that causes strep throat. Finally, there is the spiral shaped bacteria called spirilla. They look a little like corkscrews, and they are responsible for a number of diseases in humans. Some species of bacteria cause disease, but mostly bacteria live harmlessly on the skin, in the mouth, and the intestines. In fact, bacteria are very helpful to researchers. Bacterial cells resemble the cells of other life forms in many ways, and may be studied to give us insights.

body.mix: Money is not only coins and banknotes. It is anything that people are willing to use in order to represent the value of other things for the purpose of exchanging goods and services. Money enables people to compare quickly and easily the value of different commodities (such as fish and shoes), to exchange one commodity for another, and to store wealth for a long period. In the past, most societies used different objects as money. Many of these were of little value in themselves but were worth a certain amount of other goods and services because everyone agreed to them. Cowries, stone, beads and shells are some examples of such money. The most familiar form of money, coins, were first used in China and India more than 2000 years ago. Later on, other societies also started using coins. Coins are the easiest to carry and exchange. But they are less durable than other forms of money such as stone or metal. Bank notes are another form of money. Nowadays most countries use coins and banknotes only. Many countries, however, also use electronic means such as credit cards and computer bits to carry out their transactions.

body.mix: Internet is the key information technology of the present age. It is a global system of interconnected computer networks that use the standard Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP) to serve billions of users worldwide. In the last decade, internet has a great impact on our life. Now we can shop, bank, work and communicate through the internet. Today, information on any topic is available on the internet. The encyclopaedia can be consulted, news can be known, views of others can be taken and articles on any topic can be found. The communication through the internet is very cheap, convenient and faster than any other means. Through email, we can send messages to any person in any part of the world. Even video calls are possible through the internet now. Online jobs, freelance work, marketing of products, business, etc. are all possible through the internet. However, with all its advantages, internet also has its drawbacks. It is the main platform for fraudsters and terrorists. Antisocial activities can be easily and safely carried on through the internet. Besides, children waste their time on the internet. To conclude, although the internet has its drawbacks, its advantages are much more. If used properly, it can be of great help to us.

body.mix: Historians often refer to the 8th-9th century Carolingian Renaissance, the 12th century Renaissance, and the 15th-16th century Italian Renaissance as high points in the history of Western culture. It is no coincidence that these 'rebirths' occur after centuries of relative stagnation and decline. To the extent that the term 'renaissance' has any validity, it suggests that a preceding period, though marked by quiescence, actually witnessed the conservation and preservation of knowledge and the remnant of that earlier knowledge served as a necessary foundation for the subsequent flowering of scholarship. The Italian Renaissance, for example, was built upon the preservation of classical works in the monasteries of Europe. When scholars such as Petrarch, Boccaccio, and others 'rediscovered' these works, they were able to build upon them, merging the knowledge and spirit of antiquity with contemporary thought. However, these periods were not merely derivative; they displayed originality, innovation and creativity. The Carolingian Renaissance witnessed the establishment of schools, the standardization of Latin and handwriting. The 12th century Renaissance saw the founding of universities and the translation of Arabic and Greek works. The Italian Renaissance produced an explosion of art, literature, and philosophy that permanently altered the course of Western civilization. Thus, each renaissance was both a recovery of the past and a creation of something new.

body.mix: On August 28, 1963, roughly 250,000 people gathered at Washington's Lincoln Memorial, where they heard Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. deliver his 'I have a dream' speech, arguing for racial and economic justice and an end to racism in the United States. Departing from his prepared text at the urging of Mahalia Jackson, who cried 'Tell them about the dream, Martin!', King improvised on the themes he had delivered a few months earlier at a speech in Detroit. In his improvised finale, King described his dreams of freedom and equality arising from a land of slavery and hatred. King's improvisation was later described by Jon Meacham as 'one of the most consequential rhetorical moments in American history.' 'I have a dream' is considered one of the finest speeches in American history and was ranked the top American speech of the 20th century in a 1999 poll of scholars of public address. The 'I Have a Dream' speech, delivered at a historic moment in the civil rights movement, helped galvanize the movement and paved the way for the Civil Rights Act of 1964 and the Voting Rights Act of 1965. King's dream was not just of an America where individuals would not be judged by the color of their skin, but of a society where people of all races and backgrounds would live together in harmony, justice, and equality. His words continue to inspire people around the world to strive for a more just and equitable society.

body.mix: In the last two decades, the number of Bangladeshi women who have migrated to foreign countries as workers has (01) rapidly. According to a report by the Refugee and Migratory Movements Research Unit (RMMRU), the number of female workers going abroad for employment has increased nearly 20 times in the last 19 years. In 1991, only 2,313 female workers went abroad for work, but in 2010 the number rose to 27,706. The major countries to which Bangladeshi women migrate are Lebanon, the UAE, Malaysia, Mauritius, and Saudi Arabia. Though the number of female migrant workers is increasing, they often face various problems and exploitation abroad. So, proper measures should be taken to ensure their safety and rights.

body.mix: The giraffe is perhaps the most striking of African creatures. A fully grown giraffe is taller than a man, and its neck can be as long as eight feet. The giraffe has a spotted body of a golden yellowish brown, with large spots of a darker shade, and a long neck. The giraffe's main food is leaves; so it eats the leaves of tall trees. The animal's heart is very large — about two feet in length — to pump blood up its long neck to its head. The giraffe's unusual height and long neck help it to feed on leaves that other animals cannot reach, and to watch out for its enemies like the lion. Giraffes are noted for their gentle eyes and mild temperament. They can run very fast, up to fifty kilometers an hour, despite their awkward appearance.

body.mix: Bangladesh has a rich tradition of folk music. Our folk music has great variety: songs for all sorts of occasions, and songs for different castes, religions and regions. Folk music has traditionally been an important means of entertainment, a source of knowledge and a medium of social education. Mystical songs, composed by Fakirs and Bauls, express the deepest philosophical thoughts of our people. There are also narrative ballads, work songs, boat songs (Bhatiali), wedding songs, and songs connected with festivals and rituals. Folk songs are sung by the common people of rural areas, and they reflect the joys and sorrows, hopes and aspirations of ordinary men and women. Some folk songs are about love and separation, some about nature, and some contain supernatural elements. Folk music is composed by illiterate village poets and singers, and it is passed down orally from generation to generation.

body.mix: The greenhouse effect is a natural phenomenon that helps regulate the temperature of the Earth. When the sun's radiation penetrates the ground and the Earth's atmosphere, much of it is absorbed and the Earth warms up. Some of this heat is then radiated back into space. However, certain gases in the atmosphere, called greenhouse gases, trap some of this heat, keeping the Earth warm enough to support life. This process is similar to what happens in a greenhouse, where glass traps heat inside. Without the greenhouse effect, the Earth would be too cold for life to exist. However, human activities, particularly the burning of fossil fuels, have increased the concentration of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere. This enhanced greenhouse effect is causing the Earth's temperature to rise, leading to global warming and climate change. Over the past century, the average temperature of the Earth has increased by about 1.8°F. If this trend continues, it could lead to serious consequences such as rising sea levels, extreme weather events, and the loss of biodiversity.

body.mix: Recreation is a very necessary thing for all of us. Life becomes monotonous without it. Recreation refreshes our mind and body and enables us to return to work with renewed energy. It can be of many kinds: listening to music, watching films, playing games and sports, reading books, travelling, gardening, and so on. Different people choose different forms of recreation according to their taste and ability. Recreation is not merely a pastime; it has great benefits for our physical and mental health. It relieves us from the monotony of routine work, reduces stress and tension, and makes life enjoyable. Students, in particular, need recreation to break the monotony of their studies. However, recreation should be taken in moderation; too much of it can hamper our regular work.

body.mix: The Olympic Games have a long and ancient history. The ancient Olympic Games were held in Greece in honour of the Greek God Zeus. The first recorded Olympic Games took place in 776 BC in Olympia. Only Greek men were allowed to participate in the ancient Games. The ancient Olympic Games continued for nearly twelve centuries until they were abolished in AD 393 by the Roman emperor Theodosius I. The modern Olympic Games were revived by Baron Pierre de Coubertin of France. The first modern Olympics were held in Athens, Greece, in 1896. Since then, the Games have been held every four years in different cities of the world. Women were first allowed to participate in the 1900 Paris Games. body.mix: Ageing is a natural process that happens to all living beings. From the time we are born, our bodies begin to age, though the process is very slow in the early years. Ageing takes place on biological, psychological, and social levels. Biologically, ageing is the result of the accumulation of a wide variety of molecular and cellular damage over time. This leads to a gradual decrease in physical and mental capacity, a growing risk of disease, and ultimately, death. Psychologically, ageing affects memory, learning, and personality. Socially, it involves changes in roles and positions, retirement, and sometimes loneliness. Scientists have proposed various theories to explain ageing. The 'wear and tear' theory suggests that the body wears out over time due to use and damage, much like a machine. Other theories point to genetic programming and the role of free radicals and chemical processes in the body. Although ageing cannot be stopped, its effects can be slowed down by a healthy lifestyle, proper diet, regular exercise, and medical care. Gerontology is the branch of science that studies old age and the process of ageing.

body.mix: Pollution is one of the most serious problems facing the world today. It is the contamination of the environment with harmful substances that cause adverse change. There are many types of pollution: air pollution, water pollution, soil pollution, noise pollution, and radioactive pollution. Air pollution is caused by smoke from factories and vehicles, and it leads to respiratory diseases and global warming. Water pollution results from industrial waste, sewage, and chemicals being dumped into rivers and seas; it harms aquatic life and makes water unsafe for drinking. Soil pollution is caused by the excessive use of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. Noise pollution, caused by loud sounds from vehicles, industries, and loudspeakers, can cause hearing problems and stress. Pollution has become so widespread that it threatens the very existence of life on Earth. To control pollution, we must raise public awareness, enforce environmental laws strictly, plant more trees, and adopt eco-friendly technologies. Only collective effort can save our planet from this menace.

body.mix: Juvenile justice is the area of criminal law applicable to persons not old enough to be held responsible for criminal acts. In most countries, the minimum age for criminal responsibility is set by law, and children below that age cannot be charged with a crime. The main goal of the juvenile justice system is rehabilitation rather than punishment. It is based on the belief that children are different from adults in their development and capacity for change, and so they should be treated differently. Juvenile courts focus on the child's best interests, education, and reintegration into society. However, in many countries the juvenile justice system is weak and underfunded. Children in conflict with the law often face long delays, harsh conditions, and a lack of legal aid. A 'zero tolerance' approach, which imposes strict punishment for even minor offences, has been criticized for harming children rather than reforming them. Experts argue that deterrence alone does not work for children; what they need is guidance, care, and protection of their rights.

body.mix: The invention of the printing press was one of the most important events in human history. Before its invention, books were copied by hand, which was slow, expensive, and prone to errors. As a result, books were rare and only the rich could afford them. In the 15th century, Johannes Gutenberg of Germany developed a printing press with movable type. This made it possible to print books quickly and cheaply in large numbers. The printing press spread rapidly across Europe and transformed society. Knowledge and ideas could now reach a much wider audience. It accelerated the spread of education, science, and literature, and played a key role in the Renaissance, the Reformation, and the Scientific Revolution. Some historians argue that the printing press was as revolutionary in its time as the internet is today, because both dramatically reduced the cost of producing and distributing information and thereby changed the way people think and communicate.

body.mix: A rainbow is one of the most beautiful natural phenomena. It appears when sunlight passes through raindrops in the atmosphere. As the light enters a raindrop, it is refracted, or bent, then reflected inside the drop, and refracted again as it leaves. This process splits the white sunlight into its component colours — red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet — forming an arc in the sky. A primary rainbow shows red on the outer edge and violet on the inner edge. Sometimes a secondary rainbow appears outside the primary one; it is fainter and its colours are reversed. This happens when light is reflected twice inside the raindrops. Double rainbows are therefore not exactly the same as single ones. Rainbows have fascinated human beings for ages and figure in the myths and legends of many cultures. In some traditions, a rainbow is seen as a bridge between heaven and earth; in others, as a sign of hope and promise after a storm.

body.mix: Listening is an essential skill in communication, yet it is often neglected. Most of us spend more time listening than speaking, reading, or writing, but few of us are good listeners. Good listening requires concentration and effort. A good listener pays undivided attention to the speaker, does not interrupt, and tries to understand the speaker's point of view. He or she asks critical questions to clarify meaning and gives feedback to show understanding. Poor listening habits include interrupting the speaker, being distracted, judging the speaker prematurely, and thinking about what to say next instead of listening. Effective listening is important in every sphere of life — in education, at work, and in personal relationships. Teachers, doctors, managers, and leaders all need to be good listeners. Research shows that we remember only about a quarter of what we hear if we listen passively. To improve listening, one should focus on the speaker, avoid distractions, take notes where necessary, and practise patience. As the saying goes, we have two ears and one mouth so that we can listen twice as much as we speak.

body.mix: The Liberation War of Bangladesh in 1971 was a glorious chapter in the history of the Bengali nation. On the night of 25 March 1971, the Pakistani military launched a brutal crackdown on the unarmed people of East Pakistan. In response, the Bengali people rose in resistance, and a nine-month-long war of liberation began. Millions of people were displaced, and countless lives were lost. Freedom fighters, supported by the people of all walks of life, fought bravely against the occupation forces. On 16 December 1971, the Pakistani forces surrendered, and Bangladesh emerged as an independent and sovereign state. In 1975, four years after independence, the Father of the Nation, Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, was assassinated along with most of his family members, which was a great tragedy for the nation. The spirit of the Liberation War — freedom, democracy, and national unity — continues to inspire the people of Bangladesh.

body.mix: There are many stories of children who were brought up by wild animals. The most famous are Romulus and Remus, the founders of Rome, who were said to have been suckled by a she-wolf. Such stories are usually dismissed as legends. Legend has it that when a she-wolf loses her litter, she seeks a human child to take its place. This seemingly preposterous idea did not become credible until the late nineteenth century when a French doctor actually found a naked ten-year-old boy wandering in the woods. He did not walk erect, could not speak intelligibly, nor could he relate to people. He only growled and stared at them. Finally, the doctor won the boy's confidence and began to work with him. After many long years of devoted and patient instruction, the doctor was able to get the boy to clothe and feed himself, recognize and utter a number of words, and write letters and form words.

body.mix: Taxes are the first and foremost source of public revenue. Taxes are compulsory payments to government without expecting direct benefit or return by the taxpayer. Taxes collected by government are used to provide common benefits to all, mostly in form of public welfare services. Taxes do not guarantee any direct benefit for person who pays the tax. Thus it is not based on direct quid pro quo principle. Tax revenue is generated from taxes on income, profits and capital gains, taxes on goods and services which include VAT and excise duty, and taxes on permission to use goods or to perform certain activities. The government collects tax revenue by way of direct and indirect taxes. Direct taxes include corporate tax, personal income tax, capital gain tax, gift tax and wealth tax. Indirect tax includes customs duty, excise duty, VAT and service tax etc.

body.mix: Alfred Bernhard Nobel, a Swedish inventor and philanthropist, bequeathed most of his vast fortune to a trust that he designated as a fund from which annual prizes could be awarded to the individuals and organisations that had achieved through invention and discovery that which would have the greatest benefit to humanity in a particular year. According to the legend, Nobel's death had been erroneously reported in a newspaper, and the focus of the obituary was the fact that Nobel invented dynamite.
